The openwork support is carved with grooves and concentric circles. The base is figure-of eight shaped and is partially carved with triangle decoration. [JC [OPS Move] 22/3/2017]

arms.title: Knife has blade with ogee section and wooden hilt. Sheath consists of two pieces of wood, bound together by four pieces of wire and lots of rope. One side of the sheath has a pierced wooden projection through which is threaded another length of rope, probably for carrying.

Knife with long metal blade and wooden handle [.1]. Sheath [.2] consists of two pieces of wood, bound together by three pieces of wire and has pierced wooden projection for attaching carrying strap. There is minor decoration on the hilt and projection.

Long knife with wooden hilt [.1]. Sheath [.2] and hilt carved in the form of a rifle. Sheath consists of two pieces of wood, bound together by four pieces of wire, and has two pierced wooden projections for attaching carrying straps.
